Name: Lighter Craftables
Author: Grifx
Description:
[MOD RETIRED] Hey just a heads up that I've decided to retire this mod, meaning it'll stay up for download but won't be receiving updates anymore. At the moment it should still work just fine, but should the game receive any further updates this mod won't be updated along with it. I'll be working on other mods together with some friends, which might include a replacement for this one eventually but I can't say if/when any of that might be happening. If I do end up uploading a replacement mod I'll link to it here as well.

I use a bunch of mods to recolor everything (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1573]A Toned Down Stardew Valley by LavenderLight[/url], which I definitely recommend you check out), but I didn't have a mod for less saturated craftables so I made one myself. There were also some sprites of statues and the like that I didn't really like so I changed them completely (hope you like Studio Ghibli). 

You'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=description]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to run this mod.

I might bring out some more mods or add additional files to this one for the rest of the interior of the farm buildings, don't know when that will happen tho.

[22 March 2024]
Updated to version 4.0 to work with SDV 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0.0

[6 January 2021]
Updated to version 3.0 to work with smapi 1.5.

[19 July 2020]
Updated the mod to version 2.1. I also had to delete version 2.0 because it contained some files from somebody else's mod that I altered for personal use that I totally didn't forget about.
